name: Oil Rig Well Head
description: Once anchored to the terrain, a drill rod can be inserted into a well head to begin drilling a well. In order to drill effectively a drill rod should be driven by a rotary table and forced downward toward the terrain. A continuous supply of drilling slurry must be provided through the drill rod via a swivel, and the saturated drilling slurry extracted from the well head fluid port.
shortDescription: A well head for oil drilling.

logicNodes.label: Anchor
logicNodes.description: Extend / retract piles to anchor the well head to the terrain, allowing for a new well to be drilled. The well head must be close to the terrain (~1m) and upright (+-30 degrees) to be anchored. Unanchoring the well will reset any drilling progress made.

logicNodes.label: Is Anchored
logicNodes.description: Returns true when the well head is anchored to the terrain.

logicNodes.label: Drill Depth
logicNodes.description: Returns the depth of an attached drill rod in meters.

logicNodes.label: Well Depth
logicNodes.description: Returns the depth of the drilled well in meters.
